item.title: LSMSA Honors Veterans Through Student-Led Ceremony Featuring Retired Army Lieutenant Colonel (2026-11-16)
item.description: Students, faculty, staff, and community members gathered on Nov. 12 for the Louisiana School for Math, Science, and the Arts' (LSMSA) annual Veterans Day ceremony, continuing a decades-long tradition of honoring the men and women who have served in the United States Armed Forces.

item.title: Three LSMSA student-athletes earn LHSAA Academic All-State Honors (2026-11-13)
item.description: Three students from the Louisiana School for Math, Science, and the Arts (LSMSA) have earned Louisiana High School Athletic Association (LHSAA) Academic All-State honors, demonstrating that academic excellence and competitive athletics can go hand in hand.
